in_marathi.name: Ezhil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of love and fertility
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ezhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ezhil represents the God of love, fertility, and prosperity. He is often depicted with a bow and arrow, symbolizing his power to bring life and abundance.
